title: Mastering Support Vector Regression: Non-Linear SVR with RBF Kernel Explained

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome back to your Machine Learning A to Z course.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回到 Machine Learning A-Z 課程。

cues.en: Are you super excited because I am super excited about this tutorial.
cues.zh: 你非常興奮嗎？我對這堂教學非常興奮。

cues.en: We're talking about non-linear support vector regression.
cues.zh: 我們要談非線性支援向量迴歸。

cues.en: This is going to be quite an advanced tutorial but don't worry, we will break it down and as per our mission, we'll make the complex simple.
cues.zh: 這堂相當進階，但別擔心，我們會拆開說明，依照一貫的使命，把複雜變簡單。

cues.en: So before we start just wanted to make sure we're on the same page.
cues.zh: 開始前，先確認大家進度一致。

cues.en: So this is one of the most advanced tutorials in the support vector series of tutorials.
cues.zh: 這是支援向量系列中最進階的教學之一。

cues.en: Please make sure that you've completed all the previous tutorials on SVR and SVM and Kernels before proceeding with this tutorial because you'll need all that knowledge
cues.zh: 繼續之前，請確認已完成先前所有 SVR、SVM 與核心的教學，因為需要那些知識，

cues.en: to be able to tackle this one.
cues.zh: 才能處理這堂內容。

cues.en: All right, and off we go.
cues.zh: 好，開始。

cues.en: Here it is.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: So imagine you have a data set like this and you are trying to fit a support vector regression onto this.
cues.zh: 想像你有這樣一份資料集，想對它擬合支援向量迴歸。

cues.en: Plus you want to see what kind of trend line is there or what kind of equation is behind this.
cues.zh: 也想看出趨勢線，或背後是什麼方程式。

cues.en: How do you model, what kind of model can we fit to this?
cues.zh: 要如何建模？能擬合什麼模型？

cues.en: A support vector regression model.
cues.zh: 支援向量迴歸模型。

cues.en: So that you can predict what the next value is going to be for a new point that is added to the plot.
cues.zh: 這樣圖中加入新點時，就能預測下一個值。

cues.en: So if you know X, what is gonna be Y.
cues.zh: 也就是知道 X，求出 Y。

cues.en: Well you might want to try and fit a linear support vector regression and it'll look something like this.
cues.zh: 你可能試著擬合線性支援向量迴歸，結果大概長這樣。

cues.en: You'll have these support vectors, but as you can see like intuitively, you can tell it doesn't fit right?
cues.zh: 會有這些支援向量，但直覺上就看得出擬合得不好，對吧？

cues.en: Like you can tell that something is going on here beyond linear and while this it might model may be okay there somewhere at some points, clearly if you get a point with X over here
cues.zh: 可以看出這裡有超越線性的情況。雖然它可能在部分位置還算合理，但如果 X 落在這裡，

cues.en: you're gonna get the incorrect value.
cues.zh: 顯然會得到不正確的值。

cues.en: Or if X is over here, you're gonna get an incorrect value.
cues.zh: 如果 X 在這裡，也會得到不正確的值。

cues.en: It doesn't fit, looks like something else is going on You might try something like that.
cues.zh: 擬合不佳，看起來另有原因。你也可能試這樣。

cues.en: Then that won't fit as well.
cues.zh: 那也擬合不好。

cues.en: That doesn't fit.
cues.zh: 這樣不合適。

cues.en: So it doesn't look like a linear model fits here and it looks like something more complex is going on.
cues.zh: 所以線性模型看起來不適合，似乎存在更複雜的關係。

cues.en: So how do we build a support vector regression that will fit our data here?
cues.zh: 那要怎麼建立能擬合這裡資料的支援向量迴歸？

cues.en: Well, this is where non-linear SVR comes in.
cues.zh: 這就要靠非線性 SVR。

cues.en: It's gonna be quite interesting because we need to go to a new dimension.
cues.zh: 接下來很有意思，因為要進入新的維度。

cues.en: And that's why we're going to add this box.
cues.zh: 所以加上這個方框。

cues.en: It's just for visualization purposes.
cues.zh: 只是為了視覺化。

cues.en: Like our data hasn't changed.
cues.zh: 資料沒有變。

cues.en: Our axis are the same, but just for us, once we're transitioning to a third dimension to keep track of things, we're gonna add this box and we're gonna add these diagonals as well as a point, a red circle in the middle,
cues.zh: 座標軸相同，只是在轉到第三個維度時，方便追蹤變化，所以加上方框、這些對角線，以及中央的一個紅色圓點，

cues.en: just so visually we can see what's going on.
cues.zh: 讓我們看清楚發生什麼。

cues.en: It'll help us.
cues.zh: 這會有幫助。

cues.en: It's just like a visual aid.
cues.zh: 就像視覺輔助。

cues.en: Has nothing to do with the algorithm itself, it's for illustrative purposes.
cues.zh: 與演算法本身無關，純粹為了示意。

cues.en: So now we're going to actually take this and look at it from a different perspective at an angle.
cues.zh: 現在從不同角度，斜著看它。

cues.en: So at an angle it looks like this.
cues.zh: 從斜角看就像這樣。

cues.en: And that will allow us to build that dimension Z.
cues.zh: 這樣就能建立 Z 維度。

cues.en: Now let's get rid of the previous view and we're going to make a copy of it because there's gonna be quite a lot of things going on.
cues.zh: 先移除先前的視角，再做一份副本，因為會有很多變化。

cues.en: And in order to keep track of everything, we'll have two charts that are developing in parallel.
cues.zh: 為了追蹤所有內容，讓兩張圖平行發展。

cues.en: So now on the right, what we're going to do is just as we did previously with support vector machine and that's why it's important to have seen those tutorials.
cues.zh: 右邊要做的，就和先前支援向量機一樣，所以看過那些教學很重要。

cues.en: We're going to add a kernel and in this case we're gonna add a new function to take us into a third dimension.
cues.zh: 要加上核心，在這裡加入新函數，帶我們進入第三個維度。

cues.en: We're gonna add the a radial basis function or the RBF.
cues.zh: 加入徑向基底函數，也就是 RBF。

cues.en: So here, there we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: That's what it looks like.
cues.zh: 它就長這個樣子。

cues.en: That's with the RBF.
cues.zh: 這就是加入 RBF 後的樣子。

cues.en: You can see our data vaguely underneath but here you can see it more clearly.
cues.zh: 底下隱約可以看見資料，這裡則看得更清楚。

cues.en: And just to, as a reminder the formula for the RBF function is over there.
cues.zh: 提醒一下，RBF 函數公式在那邊。

cues.en: Now if we project our data onto this RBF you'll see how it works.
cues.zh: 如果把資料投影到這個 RBF 上，就能看到運作方式。

cues.en: So first of all, the center zero or this 0.0000 on x or Y axis projects straight into the very top.
cues.zh: 首先，中心的零，也就是 X 或 Y 軸上的 (0, 0)，會直接投影到最頂端。

cues.en: And if you, we discussed this before in the tutorials if you put 0, 0, L is the distance from the center you'll get the very top, you'll get a one.
cues.zh: 之前教學談過，代入 (0, 0)，L 對應中心的距離，就會得到最頂端，也就是 1。

cues.en: Now let's see how these other points, the other points in our visualization will be projected onto the view.
cues.zh: 現在看看視覺化圖中的其他點會如何投影。

cues.en: So we're gonna start with this point over here.
cues.zh: 先從這個點開始。

cues.en: So that point will be projected into this point in the Z axis somewhere here.
cues.zh: 那個點會投影到 Z 軸上這附近的點。

cues.en: By the way some of these things might not be absolutely a hundred percent accurate as I'm drawing them here but they deliver, hopefully they deliver the point home.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，我畫的部分位置可能不是百分之百精確，但希望能傳達重點。

cues.en: Okay, so now this point will be projected to over here somewhere, next point over there.
cues.zh: 好，這個點大約投影到這裡，下一個點到那裡。

cues.en: And this point, this point and then the following point will be almost at zero.
cues.zh: 這個點、這個點，接下來這個點就會幾乎是 0。

cues.en: So all this blue stuff over here, the bottom is very very close to zero, very close to zero.
cues.zh: 所以底部所有這些藍色部分都非常接近 0，非常接近。

cues.en: So as you can see, we've been keep keeping track on on the left.
cues.zh: 可以看到，左邊一直同步追蹤變化。

cues.en: We've done all of these points over here.
cues.zh: 這些點都已經處理了。

cues.en: Now the other points, the remaining points, these ones they're actually, we can't see them and not to in order not to clutter things, anything in this quadrant in this triangle here,
cues.zh: 其餘的點，也就是這些，其實看不到。為了避免畫面雜亂，這個象限、這個三角形中的所有點，

cues.en: we're not gonna plot it because it's on the back, on the opposite side of this radial basis function or, or or this view.
cues.zh: 都先不畫，因為它們在這個徑向基底函數或這個視角的背面。

cues.en: And we just not gonna plot it, but just we can just imagine that they're also projecting onto this mountain on the other side.
cues.zh: 我們不畫出來，但可以想像它們也投影到這座山的另一側。

cues.en: Now what happens next?
cues.zh: 接下來會怎樣？

cues.en: Well, next we need to, in a, these three dimensions we need to create, run a linear model.
cues.zh: 接著需要在這三個維度中建立、執行線性模型。

cues.en: So now we're in three dimensions.
cues.zh: 現在已經在三維。

cues.en: Now we can run a linear model.
cues.zh: 可以執行線性模型。

cues.en: And a linear model in three dimensions is not aligned.
cues.zh: 三維中的線性模型不是直線。

cues.en: So in two dimensions, it's a straight line.
cues.zh: 二維中是直線。

cues.en: In a three in three dimensions, a linear model is a hyperplane.
cues.zh: 三維中的線性模型則是超平面。

cues.en: So now if we run a linear model, you'll see that it will...
cues.zh: 現在執行線性模型，就會看到它，

cues.en: How does it fit our data?
cues.zh: 它如何擬合資料？

cues.en: It fits our data something like this.
cues.zh: 大概像這樣擬合資料。

cues.en: And what do we want from here?
cues.zh: 那接下來想得到什麼？

cues.en: So once we fit the hyper plane to our data in these three dimensions, what do we want from here?
cues.zh: 在三維中把超平面擬合到資料之後，接下來想得到什麼？

cues.en: We want to see where does it actually cross?
cues.zh: 我們想看它實際穿過哪裡。

cues.en: Where does it intersect our RBF, our radial based function.
cues.zh: 它在哪裡與 RBF，也就是徑向基底函數相交？

cues.en: So basically all the surface that we see here including the floor, this whole surface where does it intersect?
cues.zh: 基本上，這裡看到的整個表面，包含底部，與它在哪裡相交？

cues.en: Well it intersects over across this yellow line.
cues.zh: 就沿著這條黃線相交。

cues.en: So that's the point of intersect or the line of intersect.
cues.zh: 這就是交點，或交線。

cues.en: Now, if we get rid of the plane, we're left of this line.
cues.zh: 移除平面後，就剩下這條線。

cues.en: And if we projected back down onto the two dimensions, X and Y, look, watch what happens.
cues.zh: 如果再投影回 X、Y 這兩個維度，注意看會發生什麼。

cues.en: So we're not gonna draw it on this plot we're gonna draw it on this plot.
cues.zh: 不畫在這張圖，而畫在這張圖。

cues.en: So watch what happens.
cues.zh: 注意看。

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: That's our two dimensional line.
cues.zh: 這就是二維中的線。

cues.en: So the, so that's our intersect line projected on the two dimensional plot.
cues.zh: 也就是把交線投影到二維圖上。

cues.en: And then effectively E is our model.
cues.zh: 這實際上就是我們的模型。

cues.en: So if we now look at it in the perspective that we started with you'll see that that is what it looks like.
cues.zh: 現在回到一開始的視角，就會看到它長這樣。

cues.en: That's the non-linear SVR.
cues.zh: 這就是非線性 SVR。

cues.en: Now, I know you probably have a few questions.
cues.zh: 我知道你可能有幾個問題。

cues.en: Let's try to dig into some of the comments.
cues.zh: 來深入說明一些內容。

cues.en: So some of the concepts behind this.
cues.zh: 也就是背後的一些概念。

cues.en: So first of all, here we have this two dimensional plot.
cues.zh: 首先，這裡有這張二維圖。

cues.en: Here is our three dimension, three dimensions.
cues.zh: 這裡則是三個維度。

cues.en: So why is this SVR, right?
cues.zh: 為什麼這叫 SVR，對吧？

cues.en: So where are the support vectors?
cues.zh: 支援向量在哪裡？

cues.en: Well, in a three, in a three dimensional space SVR would run very similarly to how it runs in a two dimensional space.
cues.zh: 三維空間中的 SVR，運作方式與二維空間非常相似。

cues.en: But instead of having like a epsilon and sensitive tube, we would have an epsilon and sensitive space between hyper planes.
cues.zh: 但不再是 ε 不敏感管道，而是超平面之間的 ε 不敏感空間。

cues.en: So we, we would add these two new hyper planes.
cues.zh: 因此要加入這兩個新超平面。

cues.en: One would be epsilon above.
cues.zh: 一個位在上方 ε。

cues.en: One would be epsilon below.
cues.zh: 一個位在下方 ε。

cues.en: Rmember how we had for linear SVR we had just a tube but now here we have this space in between them.
cues.zh: 記得線性 SVR 中只有一條管道，現在則是它們之間的空間。

cues.en: And so basically what that means is any points that are in between the two most utmost hyper planes
cues.zh: 基本上，任何落在最外側兩個超平面之間的點，

cues.en: any points in between them they won't be considered towards like the error for those points will not be considered.
cues.zh: 都不會納入考量，也就是不計算這些點的誤差。

cues.en: What we wanna do is we wanna minimize the error from this epsilon instead of space to the remaining points that are outside.
cues.zh: 我們要最小化從這個 ε 不敏感空間到其餘外部點之間的誤差。

cues.en: And what this looks like over here is that's our bottom hyperplane.
cues.zh: 這裡看到的是下方超平面。

cues.en: That's its projection array or that's the projection of the part where it intersects with our real basis function.
cues.zh: 這是它的投影，或說它與徑向基底函數相交部分的投影。

cues.en: And that's the top hyperplane, that's its intersection or the projection of it's intersection.
cues.zh: 這是上方超平面，這是它的交線，或交線的投影。

cues.en: So this line over here is projected into that one.
cues.zh: 所以這裡這條線投影成那條線。

cues.en: And basically anything in between was the epsilon sensitive space now has become this Epsilon sensitive tube.
cues.zh: 原本位在 ε 不敏感空間之間的部分，現在變成這個 ε 不敏感管道。

cues.en: And these are the support vectors.
cues.zh: 這些就是支援向量。

cues.en: The crucial point here is that this is the outcome originally, this is these hyper planes are identified or built from this view from the three dimensional view.
cues.zh: 關鍵是，這是最後結果；這些超平面原本是在這個視角、三維視角中確定或建立的。

cues.en: So that's where these points come in place.
cues.zh: 所以這些點是在那裡發揮作用。

cues.en: So this point is actually underneath, we can't see it.
cues.zh: 這個點其實在下方，我們看不到。

cues.en: It's over there.
cues.zh: 就在那裡。

cues.en: And there's also these two points that are on the left.
cues.zh: 左邊還有這兩個點。

cues.en: So from here they're built.
cues.zh: 超平面是從這裡建立的。

cues.en: And then this is just a projection.
cues.zh: 接著這裡只是投影。

cues.en: Just to put it into a perspective.
cues.zh: 只是用來呈現它。

cues.en: So that's why it's still a support regression because we have these points.
cues.zh: 所以它仍然是支援向量迴歸，因為有這些點。

cues.en: Now hopefully that explains why it's a support vector regression.
cues.zh: 希望這樣能解釋為何叫支援向量迴歸。

cues.en: There's just one last thing I wanted to mention.
cues.zh: 最後還有一件事要提。

cues.en: The final thing is that everything we've been talking about here is for illustrative purposes.
cues.zh: 最後要說的是，這裡談的所有內容都是為了示意。

cues.en: In reality, the way this works is very similar to the how the support vector machine works, what we discussed about the kernel trick,
cues.zh: 實際運作方式非常接近支援向量機，也就是先前談過的核心技巧，

cues.en: that in reality we don't have to go into a third dimension to all these projections and then find our hyper planes
cues.zh: 實際上不必進入第三個維度、做這些投影，再找出超平面，

cues.en: find this epsilon sensitive space and then project everything back and get this.
cues.zh: 找出 ε 不敏感空間，接著全部投影回來得到這個。

cues.en: It would be too computationally expensive.
cues.zh: 那樣運算成本太高。

cues.en: So what we actually discussed here is a a more complex approach.
cues.zh: 所以剛才討論的其實是比較複雜的方式。

cues.en: This would be like the full fledged approach with going into a third dimension, doing the hyper planes, coming back, getting our end result,
cues.zh: 就像完整執行進入第三維、建立超平面、回來並取得最終結果的做法，

cues.en: That would be like the full Monty in a way.
cues.zh: 某種程度上是全套流程。

cues.en: But effectively what happens, or in reality is that we use the kernel trick.
cues.zh: 但實際上我們使用的是核心技巧。

cues.en: So just like with the support vector machine we don't have to go into a third dimension.
cues.zh: 和支援向量機一樣，不必進入第三個維度。

cues.en: Everything happens in the same space simply by how we use the kernel trick.
cues.zh: 透過核心技巧的使用方式，所有事情都在同樣空間中完成。

cues.en: Now we won't dive into more detail on that.
cues.zh: 現在不深入更多細節。

cues.en: I'll let you think about that in your own time on how the kernel trick would be used here because simply it's a, it's a easier concept
cues.zh: 留給你自行思考這裡如何使用核心技巧，因為它其實是比我們剛才討論的

cues.en: than what we discussed.
cues.zh: 更簡單的概念。

cues.en: By looking at the example of the kernel trick in the SVM.
cues.zh: 看過 SVM 中核心技巧的例子，

cues.en: We can extrapolate how that would work or how that would benefit us here as well.
cues.zh: 就能推想它在這裡如何運作、如何帶來好處。

cues.en: But in a nutshell this is what the non-linear support vector regression is all about.
cues.zh: 簡而言之，這就是非線性支援向量迴歸的核心概念。

cues.en: And the best part is of course, the result that it allows us to model non-linear relationships like this and get insights from our data.
cues.zh: 最棒的當然是結果，它讓我們能建模這樣的非線性關係，從資料得到洞見。

cues.en: I hope you enjoyed this tutorial.
cues.zh: 希望你喜歡這堂教學。

cues.en: This was quite an advanced concept, so congratulations on making it to the end, and I look forward to seeing you on the future tutorials in the course.
cues.zh: 這個概念相當進階，恭喜你看到最後，期待在課程接下來的教學中見到你。

cues.en: And until then, happy analyzing.
cues.zh: 在此之前，分析愉快。
